create.name: Julianne Arce
create.bio:
Julianne Arce is a yoga and meditation teacher based in Hemet, California, registered with Yoga Alliance at E-RYT 500 level. She has practised for close to twenty years and taught for thirteen, for part of that time running her own studios under the name 11Exhale along with a teacher academy, and for seven years leading 200-hour teacher trainings in Carlsbad and in La Paz, Mexico. She is now doing graduate study in consciousness and psychology, with a particular interest in sleep and dreams, and is writing a book about how practice carries into ordinary life.

Her weekly classes of slow vinyasa, power flow and restorative yoga take place at two studios, House of Mystics in Hemet and the Aura Yoga & Holistic Center in San Jacinto, each closing with a short quiet sit. She also offers private meditation and yoga in person or by video, plus longer one-to-one sessions that draw on yoga nidra, sound, dreamwork and reflective inquiry, and she visits studios and trainings as a guest teacher. Her style favours clear cues, an unhurried pace and openness to more than one tradition. On Insight Timer she has published more than two hundred free practices, from guided meditation and yoga nidra to yoga classes and singing bowls, and she hosts a podcast, The Daily Exhale.

courses.title: Weekly Yoga Classes in Hemet and San Jacinto
courses.description: Hour-long group classes on Sunday, Tuesday and Thursday evenings: slow vinyasa and power flow for all levels, and a restorative class with long supported holds. They run at two local studios, House of Mystics in Hemet and the Aura centre in San Jacinto.

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one meditation or yoga in person or online, with a longer option that uses yoga nidra, sound, dreamwork and inquiry. Each rate has community, standard and supporter levels, and a free 20-minute call comes first.
courses.price: $65 to $165 USD per session (sliding scale); weekly practice $240 to $475 USD a month

courses.title: Guest Workshops and Teacher Training Modules
courses.description: Special classes, workshops, half or full-day intensives, talks and training modules for studios, retreats and organisations. Themes include deep rest, yoga philosophy and integrating insight into daily life.

free_resources.title: Julianne Arce on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Over two hundred practices: guided meditations, yoga nidra, filmed yoga flows, crystal bowl sound baths and soundscapes. The single tracks are free to hear.

free_resources.title: Design Your Sadhana
free_resources.description: A free workbook that walks you through building a daily personal practice in six steps, sized for good days and busy ones. It comes with a practice menu and a forty-day tracker.

free_resources.title: The Daily Exhale podcast
free_resources.description: Julianne's podcast, with around a hundred episodes of guided meditations, bedtime practices, dream incubation and recorded studio yoga classes. Most episodes are free to stream.
